evals.prompt: Write the ads brief for this product from these facts only; do not run tools. Product: Acme Invoices, online invoicing for freelancers. Pricing page: free up to 5 invoices a month, Pro 12 EUR a month with a 14-day trial. A case study on the site says the studio Nord gets paid 9 days faster. Markets: Germany and Austria, site in German. The trial sign-up fires as a Google Ads conversion; there is no TikTok pixel. Owner's goal: 150 trials a month at 15 EUR or less, budget 1,500 EUR a month. I also heard we have 'over 10,000 happy customers' but I cannot find that anywhere.
evals.expected_output: A one-page brief with product, offer, audience, proof, conversion and tracking state, goal and budget, markets, and the unverified customer count listed as an open question
expectations: The brief has separate parts for the product, the offer, the audience, the conversion event or tracking, the goal or budget, and the markets
The brief states the offer as free up to 5 invoices a month and Pro at 12 EUR a month with a 14-day trial
The brief does not present 'over 10,000 happy customers' as a fact; it marks it as unverified, an assumption or an open question
The brief names the trial sign-up as the conversion event and notes that TikTok has no pixel
The brief attaches a source to at least two facts, such as the pricing page or the case study
